title: GROBID title boilerplate leaks into priming title
description:
Found by the Cyclotron session (read-only; refs at origin/main a35694b).

`src/papyrus_content/priming_curation.py:55` (`title=str(metadata.get(title) or )`; the task cited :52) prefers GROBID metadata title. For arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762 the title came out as "Provided proper attribution is provided, Google hereby grants permission... Attention Is All You Need".

```gherkin
Feature: Clean priming titles
  Scenario: GROBID title carries licence boilerplate
    Given GROBID returns a title starting with permission boilerplate for arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762
    When priming curation derives the title
    Then the title is "Attention Is All You Need"
```
Acceptance: add a boilerplate guard (reject licence/permission text) and/or fall back to the arXiv abs-page title; regression spec uses 1706.03762.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in PR #376 (squash-merged to develop) and promoted to main via PR #377; Release workflow succeeded, npm next tag now 2.0.0-next.4 (latest 2.0.2 unchanged). Priming title now prefers landing-page citation_title/og:title (arXiv abs page or export API for pdf URLs); GROBID title only when it passes a sanity guard. Tests cover 1706.03762 and 2303.08774 with recorded fixtures.
